question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Impressive
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ordinary**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Impressive** means arousing admiration and respect because of something's significance, size, quality, etc.

Example : Her speech was really **impressive**.

 
• The word **Ordinary** means typical; not out of the ordinary or unique from others

Example : This is an **ordinary** map.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Dramatic** means conspicuous, abrupt, and frequently surprising

*Example* : Why are you being so **dramatic**?

 
• The word **Significant** means huge or significant enough to be noticed

*Example* : Do you know how **significant** education is!

 
• The word **Industrious** means always exerting effort.

*Example* : She was a Industrious and obedient worker.
